metadata.name: Isaac Chronicle - Real-Time Companion
metadata.description:
Este mod conecta tu partida de Isaac con una interfaz web en tiempo real. This mod connects your Isaac run to a real-time web interface.
Second monitor / phone: real stats, nearby items (only when you get close), inventory, known synergies, floor map and run history. The mod draws NOTHING in-game. It needs the free Isaac Chronicle Companion app: https://github.com/Galfar10/Isaac-Chronicle/releases/latest
Web: https://galfar10.github.io/Isaac-Chronicle/ (or http://127.0.0.1:47823) No --luadebug needed. Works with or without REPENTOGON.
